lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Protesters gathered in front of City Hall Thursday afternoon to protest comments made by Montreal Mayor Soraya Martinez Ferrada, The Canadian Press reports.
Fully enclosed shields will be installed on 20 new Winnipeg Transit buses to protect drivers, CityNews Winnipeg reports.

Soldiers being treated in hospital for burns from a deadly fire at an Alberta military base have a long psychological recovery ahead of them, says an Edmonton surgeon treating some of the injured, The Canadian Press reports.
Trump says Putin can come to G20 if he wants, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
